channel.title: Apache SkyWalking – Community
channel.description: Recent community posts from Apache SkyWalking

item.title: Replay Claude Code Sessions Without Plugins or Configuration Changes
item.dc:creator: Sheng Wu
item.description: Replay existing Claude Code sessions with Apache SkyWalking AI Sessionizer: explore conversations, tool calls, and child-agent activity without installing a Claude Code plugin or changing its configuration.

item.title: Meet Horizon UI · 16/17: Localization in Eight Languages
item.dc:creator: Sheng Wu
item.description: Part 16 of the Meet Horizon UI series: Horizon speaks eight languages, not by re-translating on every render but as server-side overlays merged onto the same templates. Pick a language from the topbar, or click any widget on the Translations admin to translate it — while every value OAP supplies stays verbatim.

item.title: Meet Horizon UI · 17/17: Getting Started & Migration
item.dc:creator: Sheng Wu
item.description: The finale of the Meet Horizon UI series: install Horizon as a single env-driven container, point it at your OAP, and — if you're on the old UI — swap it in drop-in. Plus the OAP 10.x vs 11.x compatibility matrix: what works on the query port, and what needs OAP 11's admin host.

item.title: 认识 Horizon UI · 16/17：八种语言的本地化
item.dc:creator: 吴晟
item.description: Horizon UI 系列第十六篇：Horizon 支持八种语言。本地化不是每次渲染时重新翻译，而是在服务端把翻译 overlay 合并到同一套 template 上；用户可以从顶栏切换语言，也可以在 Translations 管理页点选任意 widget 直接补翻译，而 OAP 返回的数据始终保持原样。

item.title: 认识 Horizon UI · 17/17：安装与迁移
item.dc:creator: 吴晟
item.description: Meet Horizon UI 系列收官篇：用一个环境变量驱动的容器启动 Horizon，指向已有 OAP；如果你还在使用上一代 UI，也可以把 Horizon 平滑替换进去。文中还说明 OAP 10.x 和 11.x 的兼容边界：哪些功能只需要 query port，哪些需要 OAP 11 的 admin host。

item.title: Monitoring WeChat and Alipay Mini Programs with SkyWalking
item.dc:creator: Sheng Wu
item.description: SkyAPM/mini-program-monitor and SkyWalking OAP together extend SkyWalking's end-user monitoring to WeChat and Alipay Mini Programs. This post focuses on the data path, the cross-platform abstraction, and the OAP-side integration.

item.title: 用 SkyWalking 监控微信和支付宝小程序
item.dc:creator: 吴晟
item.description: SkyAPM/mini-program-monitor 与 SkyWalking OAP 配合，把微信和支付宝小程序纳入 SkyWalking 的端用户体验监控。本文聚焦数据通路、双平台抽象与 OAP 端集成。

item.title: Agentic Vibe Coding in a Mature OSS Project: What Worked, What Didn't
item.dc:creator: Sheng Wu
item.description: What happens when you apply agentic AI coding to a mature open-source project with real users, real compatibility contracts, and real consequences? 77K lines changed in 5 weeks — here's what I learned.

item.title: 在成熟开源大型项目中实践 Agentic Vibe Coding：软件工程与工程控制论还在延续
item.dc:creator: 吴晟
item.description: 当你把 AI 智能体编程应用到一个有真实用户、广泛运用、API 被充分集成的成熟开源项目时，我在 5 周改了 7.7 万行代码，里面到底用到了哪些方法？这是我的实战总结。

item.title: Apache SkyWalking 2025 in Review: Making BanyanDB Ready for Production
item.dc:creator: Sheng Wu
item.description: A review of Apache SkyWalking community work in 2025, with a focus on BanyanDB becoming the production-grade native storage for SkyWalking.

item.title: Improving Alert Accuracy with Dynamic Baselines
item.dc:creator: Han Liu
item.description: This article explores how to leverage history metrics to generate dynamic baselines for a future period, thereby enhancing the accuracy of alerts.

item.title: 开源之夏 2024 SkyWalking 社区项目情况公示
item.dc:creator: Apache SkyWalking
item.description: 开源之夏是由中科院软件所“开源软件供应链点亮计划”发起并长期支持的一项暑期开源活动，旨在鼓励在校学生积极参与开源软件的开发维护，培养和发掘更多优秀的开发者，促进优秀开源软件社区的蓬勃发展，助力开源软件供应链建设。12月9日，官方完成最终审核和官方评优，并发布结果。

item.description: 本文将介绍如何使用 R3 识别 RESTFul URI 并将其集成到 SkyWalking 中。
